description: Browse curated Wiro models grouped by category. Choose a model and call `get_model_schema` before `run_model`.
name: explore

discountPercent.description: Your discount on this model, in percent. It comes off the part of a charge paid from deposits; coupon credit and store revenue pay first, at the list price in pricing.

estimatedCostUsd.description: Estimated USD cost of one run: the average of past runs for a model billed by run time, or the listed estimate of a price set when the run ends. Null when there is no such estimate, as for a model priced by its options: see pricing.

title: Explore Wiro models
